question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**Adress**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The erroneous spelling is '**Adress**'
 
• Let's look at the correct meaning of the word and its spelling.
 
• **Address**: the particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated.
 
 
• **Example**: *The delivery guy asked me if I knew the **address **__given on the package.*
 
 

**Hence, the correct answer is option 1**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__** 

__
 
• The word address has another meaning.
 
• **Address: **a formal speech delivered to an audience.
 
 
• **Example**: *The Prime Minister is scheduled to **address **__the nation on 8 August at 8 pm.*
